recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless OO later decides that code generation needs an explicit type-name extension in addition to the existing contentReference reuse.
issue_request: FHIR-32785 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R5. It originally asked to add structuredefinition-explicit-type-name to DeviceDefinition.packaging.udiDeviceIdentifier because two separately declared udiDeviceIdentifier BackboneElement types confused some code generators; the accepted modified resolution was to refer to the existing DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier type instead.
initial_application: Git commit 48c1520a30dee406f5febe4f35fb614d6f1f0441 applied FHIR-32785 by replacing the nested BackboneElement declaration for DeviceDefinition.packaging.udiDeviceIdentifier with contentReference="#DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier" and removing the duplicate child element declarations. No prior AutoFHIR reconciliation commit for FHIR-32785 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml is in current build scope. OO HCP minutes on 2022-07-11 record the proposed 'see (udiDeviceIdentifier)' approach after checking with Lloyd and the submitter, and 2022-07-18 minutes record the 6-0-0 motion adopting it. The R5 published DeviceDefinition profile exposes the same contentReference. Zulip searches for the issue key and DeviceDefinition UDI terms found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current in-scope source already has DeviceDefinition.packaging.udiDeviceIdentifier as max '*' with contentReference '#DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier', and duplicate packaging.udiDeviceIdentifier child definitions are absent.
